SELECT "mn"."id", "mn"."createdAt", "mn"."createdBy", "mn"."concept", "mn"."type", "mn"."schema", "mn"."payload", "mn"."metadata", "mn"."provenance" FROM (SELECT "mn"."id", "mn"."createdAt", "mn"."createdBy", "mn"."concept", "mn"."type", "mn"."schema", "mn"."payload", "mn"."metadata", "mn"."provenance" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) "mn"."id", "mn"."createdAt" FROM "MemoryNodes" AS "mn" WHERE (concept = 'v1:pipelines:run') ORDER BY id ASC, "createdAt" DESC) AS latest_keys JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM "MemoryNodes" UNION ALL SELECT * FROM memory_liveness) AS observed WHERE id=latest_keys.id AND "createdAt"=latest_keys."createdAt" LIMIT 1) AS mn ON true) AS mn WHERE ((((concept = 'v1:pipelines:run') AND (jsonb_typeof(payload->'ownerUserId') = 'string' AND payload #>> '{ownerUserId}' = 'v1:identity:user:os-list-evidence-owner')) AND (((jsonb_typeof(payload->'ownerUserId') = 'string' AND payload #>> '{ownerUserId}' = 'v1:identity:user:os-list-evidence-owner') OR TRUE = TRUE) OR ((jsonb_typeof(payload->'accountId') = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(payload->'accountId') > 0) OR (jsonb_typeof(payload->'accountId') = 'string' AND (payload->'accountId' #>> '{}') <> ''))))) ORDER BY ((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(payload->'queuedAt') = 'string' AND btrim(payload #>> '{queuedAt}', '
